tvShow.name: The Traitors
tvShow.overview: Deception, lies and betrayal are the name of the game, as four Traitors infiltrate a group of 24 players and use their skills to eradicate 'loyal' contestants trying to win $250,000 in silver bars.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Deception, lies and betrayal are the name of the game, as four Traitors infiltrate a group of 24 players and use their skills to eradicate 'loyal' contestants trying to win $250,000 in silver bars.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Suspicions are forming and contestants must decide whether to investigate Olivia's rumour or listen to the predictions of clairvoyant Chloe. Do The Faithful have what it takes to expose the Traitors?

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Remaining undetected so far, the Traitors are riding high, but a dramatic prediction has changed the game. As the heat turns up on two of them, will Traitor turn on Traitor to keep the faith?

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In today's silver bar challenge, the group must find a way to cross a bridge covered with trapdoors spanning a vast drop. Then, can The Faithful finally expose a Traitor before they kill again?

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The silver prize is growing, and so is the heat in Traitors Tower as one of the killers fumes about their teammates' subterfuge. Then, a mysterious note throws The Traitors game into further disarray.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Today, players must correctly assemble safety markings on an airstrip runway so that three World War 2 planes loaded with silver bars can land. Then, will The Faithful succeed in banishing a Traitor?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: In tonight's vital Shield Challenge, one lucky contestant will win exemption from both banishment and murder. Then watch as chaos, lies and deception unfold in the all-important Banishment Ceremony,

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As suspicion and paranoia continue to grow, one contestant has secretly turned into a Traitor overnight, leaving The Faithful more on edge than ever. Then, players do time in an epic $20k jail break.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: With a new Team Traitor recruit in the house, the Faithful scramble to uncover the defector. With names flying everywhere, knowing who to trust just got harder. Who will be thrown under the bus next?

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The newest Traitor starts to subtly plant seeds and sew suspicion, steering The Faithful in a fellow Traitor's direction. Players must then dodge lasers and nab artworks in a heist at an art gallery.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Fear of heights are tested once again with an $18k Silver Challenge high above the treetops. Meanwhile, the latest recruit throws a fellow Traitor's name into the spotlight to see if it sticks.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: With a big pile of silver up for grabs and the finish line in sight, do the Faithful have what it takes to win? Or will they let a Traitor slip through to the end in this season's finale?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Rodger Corser returns to host this devious game of deception. Twenty new players, an exciting mix of everyday Aussies and familiar faces, will band together to win up to $250,000 in silver bullion.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With another Fathful lost, distrust is rife as even the Traitors begin to turn on each other.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: It's a war between Traitors after a blindside happened at the last banishment. The challenge adds $16k to the pot, but as a coup is attempted, the Faithful are becoming suspicious.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Following the shocking events of last night's Banishment, the hunt for the Traitors has only just begun.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: No one is innocent, as both Traitors and Faithful become tangled in the web of lies and deception.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After last night's explosive banishment, trust has been lost between players who failed to protect each other. One Traitor suspects a Faithful is onto them, what will they do?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The Traitor's powers are growing. But will this lead to their downfall?

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: With the end in sight and the prize pot on the line, the game has taken a turn and no one is safe.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: And then there were five. But, will mistrust between the Traitors threaten to derail their final plans?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ringmaster of ruin Gretel Killeen invites 22 infamous Australians to Claremont Manor to play the ultimate game of trust and treachery, with a stab at winning $250,000.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A bombshell breakfast shakes the players as the first murder victim is revealed. As the game gets underway, strategies shift, and alliances begin to form.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Another murder places the players on high alert. As suspicions run wild, alliances begin to fracture, and accusations fly. The mission reveals new tensions, and a bomb is dropped at the Roundtable.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Elation reigns as all players survive the night, but the Traitors' unexpected twist sows total confusion, and the Roundtable devolves into chaos. Think you know who to trust? Think again.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Cracks form as the pressure mounts, and an unexpected murder wreaks havoc in the manor. Fingers start to point at each other as the Faithful desperately try to hunt down a Traitor.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: At the halfway point, mayhem reigns, and the Traitors remain as elusive as ever. But strategy begins to pay off during a volatile Roundtable as the Faithfuls hunt for their first taste of blood.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: An unexpected success buoys the players as they face another day in the manor. But facades begin to unravel as the tension reaches a boiling point.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Fresh certainty amongst the players manufactures a manor-wide mystery, and the mission brings a dangerous edge to the Round Table. But have the players gotten too confident?

reviews.author: ChristlichenSoldaten
reviews.content: Season 3 has been the biggest letdown. I am not a fan of the new host. She's very off-putting and I miss Rodger. he was witty and fun. the new hostess person is kind of yucky and gives a bad and unhappy vibe.
